text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted El Condor Pasa
smiling at a café table.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
A present arrived from my family, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just one spoonful and you'll take flight!
It's my family's secret hot sauce recipe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pour this on your food, and you'll get a burst of energy! Erupción!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So, I ordered double my usual menu items!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I use this and eat a whole bunch,
an unbroken win streak is guaranteed!
choice_data_list: It'd be a waste to use it all up at once.
Let's eat plenty and get stronger!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? Is that so, desu? If it can make you stronger,
I'd say nothing beats that, right?
choice_data_list: Let's save it for the right moment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: When you say 'a crucial moment'... do you mean like an important race, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! So if you eat this before an important race,
you can run it in top condition, YES?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As expected of El's Trainer!
I almost scarfed it all down in one bite—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Wha?! Come to think of it,
I already ordered the food~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gracias, Trainer-san!
Well then, I'll save the sauce
for a special occasion...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's have lunch together!
Food tastes twice as delicious when two people eat it together, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm gonna eat a ton
and get stronger and stronger...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Curry, fried rice, omurice!
I'll dye them all bright red without leaving a single speck, and turn them all into power desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, El Condor Pasa devoured
all of the massive lunch she had brought,
dousing every last bit in bright red sauce.
